test_automation_issues.issue: Playwright browser sessions lose authentication when creating new automation contexts. Each mcp_browser_automation call creates a fresh browser without previous session cookies/localStorage, causing redirect to login page.
test_automation_issues.impact: Unable to complete all test scenarios (UI-1c, UI-3-UI-7) in separate automation sessions. Tests must be run in single continuous session.
test_automation_issues.workaround: All tests should be executed in one long-running Playwright script without breaking into multiple mcp_browser_automation calls
test_automation_issues.fix_priority: MEDIUM - Testing infrastructure issue, not product bug
